# Copilot instructions

The instructions for this repository live in [`AGENTS.md`](../AGENTS.md) at the repo root, shared by
every agent. This file is a pointer and holds no content of its own.

Read, in this order, before proposing changes:

1. [`AGENTS.md`](../AGENTS.md) - philosophy, architecture, coding conventions, constraints.
2. [`CONTRIBUTING.md`](./CONTRIBUTING.md) - the contribution protocol. Parts of it are enforced by a
   CI check that blocks the merge, including the branch name, the issue it points at, and the
   `Closes #<issue>` line in the pull request body.
3. [`JARGON.md`](./JARGON.md) - shared domain vocabulary. `dev` means the recruitment team here, not
   software engineers.
